decision_conditions: The proposed development hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with the Noise Impact Assessment prepared by DAA Group dated 5 February 2024 (Issue 01).
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not become operational until a scheme for:-
</p><p>(a) Plans showing the proposed storage of refuse/waste at the property; and</p><p>(b) details on proposed collection;</p><p>have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. </p><p> The development shall be carried out in accordance with the above details to be approved in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

Notwithstanding the approved drawings, no outdoor, on-street seating area associated with the development hereby permitted, whether permanent or temporary, shall not be allowed unless appropriate Pavement Licenses have been obtained from Harrow's Highways department.&nbsp;

Prior to operation of the development hereby permitted, a post-installation report must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority that the proposed extractor fan/s and associated external equipment has been installed in accordance with the mitigation measures recommended in the Odour Assessment submitted with the application, prepared by&nbsp;Nendle Manufacturing Ltd dated 29 February 2024.&nbsp;
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Drawing no. 1, Drawing No. 2, Drawing No. 12 REV 1, Drawing No. 13 REV 1.

<p>Prior to operation of the development hereby permitted, an acoustic certificate must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, demonstrating that that the proposed extractor flue or any other mechanical/ventilation equipment installed, does not emit a noise level exceeding 39dB(A) at all neighbouring residential windows between the hours of 7:00 to 23:00 hours and 35dB(A) between the hours of 23:00 to 7:00 hours, or otherwise does not exceed background noise levels.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Prior to operation of the proposed development hereby permitted:</p><p>(a) a Delivery and Serving plan must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, including the following information:</p><p style="margin-left: 25px;">(i) the physical design and layout of the site, and how it provides adequate provision for delivery and servicing activity from day one;</p><p style="margin-left: 25px;">(ii) the day-to-day policies and measures which will be implemented so that deliveries and servicing are appropriately managed, and how the disruption and environmental impact of that activity locally will be minimised over time. It should set appropriate targets for continuous improvement where appropriate; and</p><p style="margin-left: 25px;">(iii) the forecast trip rates for the site.</p><p>(b) The approved Delivery and Servicing Plan approved as per part (a) must be adhered to at all times for the lifetime of the development.&nbsp;</p>
description: New shopfront; installation of extract canopy to rear
